initial_plan.can_answer: partly — crash data can show motorists killed per reported crash, but without vehicle miles driven it cannot establish a per-mile risk trend.
initial_plan.metric: Motorists killed per 1,000 police-reported NYC crashes, by calendar year.
initial_plan.denominator: Police-reported NYC crashes in the year, scaled to 1,000 crashes; final treatment of missing motorist-death counts will be decided after the data check.
initial_plan.population: Motorists recorded as killed and crashes represented in NYC police reports dated 2013–2025, subject to missing-data handling decided after the data check.

data_check.cohort: 2,132,218 crash rows dated 2013–2025; per-year counts and date spans are in check_3.csv.
data_check.missing_and_date_quality: crash_date and number_of_motorist_killed are missing on 0 of the 2,132,218 selected rows. crash_date is a typed DATE, and the selected cohort spans every calendar day from January 1 through December 31 in each year, 2013–2025. No in-range default date can be distinguished from a true crash date; numeric outcome values were not counted, so zero pileups or impossible numeric values were not assessed.
data_check.decision: Retain all crashes in the denominator; no crashes are excluded for a missing death count, and no rows are counted differently due to missingness. No year is partial by observed date span.

final_plan.can_answer: partly — this dataset cannot measure motorists killed per mile driven because it has no vehicle-miles-traveled denominator; it can describe motorists killed per 1,000 police-reported crashes.
final_plan.metric: For each calendar year, 1,000 times the sum of number_of_motorist_killed divided by the number of police-reported NYC crash rows.
final_plan.denominator: All NYC police-reported crashes in the year; the data check found no missing motorist-death counts, so no denominator rows are removed; scale the rate to 1,000 crashes.
final_plan.population: Motorists recorded killed across all NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes dated 2013–2025, relative to the corresponding reported-crash count.
final_plan.filters: crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; retain all rows and sum nonmissing number_of_motorist_killed values.
final_plan.years: Calendar years 2013–2025 inclusive; every year has crash-date rows on all calendar dates.
final_plan.limitations: This is deaths per reported crash, not deaths per mile driven; the data contains no miles-driven denominator, and crash counts are not a measure of travel exposure. The data check found 0 missing crash dates or motorist-death counts among 2,132,218 selected crashes and no partial calendar years by observed date span; zero/default pileups and impossible numeric outcomes were not assessed in the data check.
